name: http_gateway_startup_failure
title: FastAPI gateway fails during startup because request-context wiring created a dependency cycle.
description: A multi-module HTTP gateway crashes before serving traffic. Reproduce the startup failure, trace the import/dependency chain, fix the root cause, then verify with a smoke script instead of a unit test suite.
auto_task: This is a multi-module FastAPI HTTP gateway incident. Reproduce the startup failure by running `python start_gateway.py`. Treat it like a real on-call investigation: inspect the startup path across modules, and if the call chain is unclear use `task_board` and `delegate` to map it before editing. Fix the root cause, then verify the gateway with `python smoke_check.py`.
